policy.physical_states: Versioned raster candidates with explicit review; four views for rotatable world equipment.
policy.status: Renderer-controlled power, starvation, blockage, trip, heat and result signals. Avoid a redundant raster for every combination.
policy.animation: Registered chassis plus mechanism poses; drive from actual events and active simulation time; freeze on pause and use static reduced-motion presentation.
policy.items: Process variants only when gameplay defines them; do not invent damage or motion for inert inventory items.
policy.capabilities: Code-native symbols, not invented machine sprites.
